title: Cuba before 1959
goal: See what Cuba was like before the revolution, and describe how things used to be with soler.

items: I can say how Cuba became a republic and what influence the United States had.
I can describe the sugar economy of the 1950s.
I can describe the difference between Havana and the countryside.
I can say what happened on 10 March 1952.
I can describe how things used to be with soler.
